EXHIBIT 99.1 — PRESS RELEASE (SYNTHETIC, FICTIONAL)

Synthetic Semiconductor Co reports results for the third quarter of fiscal 2027.

Revenue for the quarter was $35.1 billion, up 12% from the prior quarter.

GAAP earnings per diluted share for the quarter were $0.79.

Non-GAAP earnings per diluted share for the quarter were $0.81.

GAAP gross margin was 74.6%.

Revenue is expected to be $37.5 billion, plus or minus 2%, for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027.
